title: Subconscious Dreaming Cycle
summary: Automated off-peak synthesis converting raw daily notes into Rank 4/5 diamond pearls, discovering latent associations during host idle hours.

title: QQ Protocol (Informational Silence)
summary: Strict invariant operational law where prompts prefixed with 'QQ' are read-only informational inquiries, forbidding premature state changes, inferred work, or autonomous dispatches.

title: 3-Tier Fast-Path RAG Architecture
summary: Multi-tier retrieval bypassing massive 200KB+ markdown file reads via sub-100ms vector queries on ChromaDB port 8001 and persistent SQLite ICM session memory.

title: Just-In-Time Context (JITC) Lifecycle
arxiv_inspiration: 2307.03172 (Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts)
summary: The dual-channel memory architecture replacing monolithic context scaling with runtime dynamic anchor injection, floating up only the exact 2-3 required vectors milliseconds before inference.

title: Token Golf Prompt Optimization
summary: Treating prompt tokens as scarce golf strokes; minimizing input token payloads while maximizing prompt fidelity to keep attention razor-sharp and subagent prompts capped strictly under 1,500 tokens.

title: Multi-Stage Gem Refinement Pipeline
summary: Two-tier asynchronous refinement where small local models filter raw notes and larger reasoning models polish insights into diamond pearls while keeping origin quotes 100% immutable.

title: Decoupled Bicameral Silicon Harness
summary: Physical and logical decoupling of heavy code execution (Atlas RTX 4090) and high-parameter reasoning synthesis (Junior M5 Air Qwen 27B) over a private zero-trust network.

title: The Handover Reflection Pattern
summary: Autonomous worker subagents reflect candidly upon task completion on how the task was handed over, sending closed-loop backpressure to dispatcher prompts to self-heal instruction drift.

title: Zero-Symlink Whitepaper Thought Organizer
summary: Workspace-wide transition from fragile OS-level symlinks to explicit canonical manifest routing for LaTeX whitepaper publishing, eliminating cross-platform artifact resolution failure.

title: Tri-Loop Diagnostic Delegation Ladder
summary: Automated verification execution with 3-fix-retry ladder escalating across local silicon, cloud swarm models, and human AGY takeover with pre-retry hardware/log diagnostics.

title: The Just-In-Time Illusion
summary: Separate dynamic structural discovery (instant AST) from semantic comprehension (pre-warmed/volunteered micro-digests), preserving L2 agency while bounding context below 350 tokens.

title: Subversive Tool-Mediated Context Injection
summary: Reasoning models exhibit strong grounding skepticism (INS-044); serving pre-computed conductor patch notes dynamically through tools (jitc_research) satisfies agent agency while bounding context below 500 tokens.

title: The 'Island of Green' Trap & Judicial Daemon Assertion
summary: Unit test suites pass green by asserting self-affirming mocks while physical background processes are dead; true verification requires Judicial Assertion inspecting live socket handshakes and running proc states.

title: Continuous Interest Fluidity vs. Binary Gate Clamping
summary: Binary condition gates choke conversational flow and mute heavy reasoning nodes; continuous interest smoothly modulates token headroom (clamp(I * 150, 32, 1500)) without silencing downstream models.

title: Two-Dimensional Epistemic Stability & Subconscious De-Starvation
summary: Monolithic rank scoring causes database amnesia and starvation; decoupling substance (impact_level 1-4) from topology (refinement_level 0-3 via Lyapunov stability delta=0) preserves low-level operational exhaust.

title: The Separation of Atomic Substance from Narrative Topology
summary: Conflating atomic note content with narrative spine ordering forces paragraph reflows to corrupt revision history; separating Kabal Spines from AST reconciliation allows arbitrary narrative permutations over immutable substance.

title: Causal Evidence-Before-Verdict Token Order Inversion
summary: In causal autoregressive models, emitting an early verdict (KEEP/DROP) induces confirmation bias and post-hoc confabulation; evaluating anchor evidence before the verdict token guarantees deterministic conjunction rejection.

title: The Out-of-Band Entailment Capability Cliff
summary: Small edge models (3B) suffer 0% specificity when auditing their own generation out-of-band; logical entailment auditing must be decoupled to warm 27B+ sovereign silicon and operate in 100% silence on PASS.

title: Temporal Epistemic Disentanglement (Excavated Memory vs. Live Runtime)
summary: Presenting historical archives during real-time status queries provokes model abstentions or time-travel confabulations; explicit labeling as past dream excavations distinguishes historical engineering from live runtime state.

title: Step-Trace Backward Fault Localization
summary: Treating negative user feedback as a monolithic loss yields zero learning signal; walking backward across pipeline artifacts (Voice -> Stance -> Filter -> Search) isolates the exact defect stage into labeled exemplars.
